inScope: BattleSceneController target-input routing and draft-marker lifetime.
BattleSceneController held-weapon suppression and projectile-sprite mapping.
Focused resource/presentation contract and the existing end-to-end simulation test.
completionCriteria: Orbital rocket has no generic aim drag or equipped item beside the droid.

Selecting another weapon, turn expiry, or confirmation removes the visible draft marker.
The spawned orbital projectile resolves its explicit missile asset instead of the generic circle.
